_readme: This is the ONLY place OIL's real column names should ever be written down. Edit this file once OIL's official export format is known — no code changes required. Left side = canonical schema field, right side = OIL's actual column header. The values below are placeholder guesses based on the SIH26165 brief's own example ('Observation Description' -> report_text, 'Observation Type' -> report_type, 'Area' -> location) and MUST be verified/corrected against the real file before use. You can also override this mapping per-upload via the API without editing this file.
